content: Each million units of penicillin G contains 6.8 mEq of sodium. This product is available in tray packs of 10 units (NDC 0781-6153-95) and tray packs of 50 units (NDC 0781-6153-97). Storage Instructions: The dry powder should be stored at a temperature of 20°C to 25°C (68°F to 77°F), in accordance with the USP Controlled Room Temperature guidelines. Once reconstituted into a sterile solution, it can be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature of 2°C to 8°C for up to 3 days without significant loss of potency.
